answer: Census bond: each identity locks 50 credits for one marble plaque on the roll. Each epoch the auditor posts the roll on the ledge; each identity answers with a quill-signed entry naming it. A missing or borrowed answer burns the bond. A rented plaque fails: a second quill signature under one plaque exposes the ring. First fake costs 50, the kth 50+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 2,547,500 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 50 once and keep it.
